title: Default-off Q8_0 up-only pre-fallback skip correctness gate

bottleneck_component.name: DeepSeek decode CPU up/down fallback plus source/page behavior

prior_evidence.up_output_write_top1: passed for blk.0.ffn_up_exps.weight with max 64 overwrite calls
prior_evidence.limitation: The passing up output-write path still executed CPU fallback, so it did not prove a performance path.

candidate.name: Q8_0 CUDA up skip before CPU fallback
candidate.why_not_benchmark_yet: This is the first path that can skip CPU fallback, but it must pass token-level correctness before any timing benchmark.
candidate.expected_ram_pressure: temporary CUDA/host buffers for matching up tensors only; verifier runs in 16GB cgroup
candidate.expected_ttft_impact: not evaluated in this correctness gate

implementation_boundary: Add a separate default-off env-gated pre-fallback skip path.
Enable only when GGML_MOE_STREAM_Q80_SKIP_NAME_FILTER is set.
Guard the skip path to ffn_up_exps only; down is known token-level failing.
Run CUDA MXFP4 x Q8_0 before CPU fallback, write dst, and set matrix_row_counts[cur_a]=0 only when CUDA reports success.
Do not touch the accepted default path, direct hot pool, gate cache, or existing q80 write correctness gate.
Do not promote or benchmark until fixed-text top1 passes.
correctness_gate: Create baseline result.gguf with skip disabled.
Run check with GGML_MOE_STREAM_Q80_SKIP_NAME_FILTER=blk.0.ffn_up_exps.weight and a small max call limit.
Pass condition: llama-results exits 0, same_top1 == n_tokens, first_mismatch_pos == -1.
If top1 fails, revert skip runtime source and keep only rejected documentation.
promotion_rule: This step cannot be promoted as SOTA. A later benchmark requires strict cold drop_caches, 16GB cgroup including page cache, TTFT gate, France correctness, full metadata, commit/push, and pushed-source reproduction.
